Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (July 10, 2025) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Doc4781406813 Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of Fire Station appliances including all labour, materials, parts and equipment, travel, and supervision necessary to provide delivery, and setting in place of appliances and certain services to the City of Toronto Fire Services for a period of one (1) year, with the option to renew the Contract on the same terms and conditions for an additional four (4) separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised, then the Fire Chief and General Manager will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.…
